title: Blink vs Lovable: Which AI App Builder Should You Use in 2026?
summary: Blink vs Lovable compared: full-stack builder vs frontend generator. See pricing, features, and which is right for founders who want to ship.
body_markdown: Lovable's frontend generation is accessible to non-technical users, but the backend setup is a genuine obstacle. Setting up Supabase (row-level security, schema management, environment variables) and Vercel (build configuration, serverless functions, custom domains) requires meaningful technical knowledge. Many non-technical Lovable users get stuck at this stage.[Blink](https://blink.new/) was specifically designed for non-technical founders — the entire stack is generated and deployed together, so you never have to leave the chat interface to configure infrastructure.
